body.name: qsim
body.def: On \(\{\widehat T_n\ge T_0\}\), \(\widehat q^{\mathrm{sim}}_{n,\alpha}\) is the empirical \((1-\alpha)\)-quantile of \(n^2\) independent copies of \(M_{\widehat T_n}^{\mathrm{sim}}\), with mesh \(\Delta(b(\widehat T_n))\) and padding \(R(b(\widehat T_n))\); set it to \(+\infty\) on \(\{\widehat T_n<T_0\}\).
